parsed.explanation: State-directed, visitor-facing enforcement is documented and recurring, not latent. Entry screening at the two main airports compares appearance to passport sex; 2025 cases saw trans women X-rayed to verify genital anatomy, mocked, refused entry and stripped of passports, with refusals documented across a decade (2016, 2022, 2025). Gender nonconformity is criminally punishable: the 2017 case shows a trans visitor imprisoned a year under the presentation offence, held in an 'effeminate detainees' cell, head shaved and her hormone pills discarded before deportation-conversion — with a 2011 police campaign and 2020 dress-based deportations. Detention carries documented beatings and forced rectal exams. No legal recognition, no recourse, no advocacy organisations, censored media. This is engineered discovery at every crossing paired with imprisonment and custody abuse — severe risk, short of the near-certain-execution tier, and mitigated slightly by the narrower post-2022 statute.
